params.name: page
params.description: The zero indexed page of results. A mimimum value of 0 and a maximum of 10 will be accepted.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. A mimimum value of 1 and a maximum of 100 will be accepted.

params.name: statuses
params.description: A comma-delimited list of Zocodc appointment statuses to filter appointments by.

params.name: developer_patient_id
params.description: The patient identifier provided by 3P developer to filter appointments by.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The field to sort appointments by. Default is start_time.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: The direction to sort appointments by. Default is descending.

params.name: practice_ids
params.description: The comma separated values of practice ids to filter appointments by

params.name: provider_ids
params.description: The comma separated values of provider ids to filter appointments by

params.name: location_ids
params.description: The comma separated values of location ids to filter appointments by

params.name: start_time_utc_min
params.description: The minimum UTC start time of the appointments to fetch. Exclude appointments that start before this time.

params.name: start_time_utc_max
params.description: The maximum UTC start time of the appointments to fetch. Exclude appointments that start after this time.

params.name: created_time_utc_min
params.description: The minimum UTC created time of the appointments to fetch. Exclude appointments that were created before this time.

params.name: created_time_utc_max
params.description: The maximum UTC created time of the appointments to fetch. Exclude appointments that were created after this time.

params.name: last_modified_time_utc_min
params.description: The minimum UTC last modified time of the appointments to fetch. Exclude appointments that were last modified before this time.

params.name: last_modified_time_utc_max
params.description: The maximum UTC last modified time of the appointments to fetch. Exclude appointments that were last modified after this time.

This endpoint retrieves the paginated list of appointment details and statuses for the given credential. By default, appointments will be returned in descending order of start time.

A maximum of 1,000 total appointments will be returned via pagination; if more are expected, use filters and batch requests.

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves the participants of an appointment. Developers must provide a valid `appointment_id` as a path parameter, and Zocdoc returns the participants of that appointment.

This endpoint is used to request the cancellation of an appointment in a non-cancelled status. (Non-cancelled statuses include: pending_booking, booking_failed, confirmed, pending_reschedule, reschedule_failed and rescheduled)

This endpoint is used to confirm an appointment in pending booking status. Developers must send a valid `appointment_id` as input in the request body.

This endpoint is used to only modify the appointment time and request the reschedule of an appointment in pending_booking, confirmed, pending_reschedule, or rescheduled status. Developers must send a valid `appointment_id` and a new start time as input in the request body.

This endpoint is used to upload attachment documents related to the appointment for the provider to view. You can upload more than one attachment with the same attachment_type for the same appointment_id if needed. The provider will be able to receive all uploaded attachments. 

Only documents of type jpg, png, pdf, and docx are supported. Documents must be less than 100MB. You may not upload attachments to appointments in a failed state or over 7 days after the appointment.

Use this endpoint to update the status of an appointment to either 'arrived' or 'no_show'.
- `arrived`: Indicates the patient has arrived at the office.
- `no_show`: Indicates the patient did not show up for their scheduled appointment. Appointment start time should be in the past but no older than 2 days to be marked as no_show.
